daily.title: Half of Australia's windfarm pipeline is in slowest-building state
daily.summary: Queensland holds half of Australia's proposed onshore wind capacity, but policy and community challenges are making it the slowest state to build the projects.

daily.title: Breaking: Townsville hospital could have been mitigated urology failings years earlier
daily.summary: An independent investigation has found failings in urology at Townsville Hospital and Health Service could have been mitigated by the board years earlier.

daily.title: Breaking: Macquarie faces $14m fine for savings rate failures
daily.summary: Macquarie Bank has admitted to failures in the promotion of its "welcome" interest rate for new savings account customers.

daily.title: Coral colony the size of three MCGs thriving off remote Australian island
daily.summary: An enormous rose coral colony, one of the largest ever recorded, is mapped by a team of researchers off the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.

daily.title: Gold Coast AFLW player delisted just weeks out from giving birth
daily.summary: The AFLW's pregnancy policy is called into question with a Suns player delisted just weeks out from giving birth.

daily.title: Legends urge Australia to 'move on' from Sandpapergate amid opposing claims
daily.summary: As Mitchell Starc and Usman Khawaja's recollections of the 2018 incident differ, Adam Gilchrist says Australia must move on.

daily.title: US charges three men over terror plots, including planned assault on UK airbase
daily.summary: Three men are charged by US authorities with plotting a "campaign of terror" of nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities in Europe and the US and the British military base at RAF Fairford.

daily.title: Meghan Markle's father jailed for cutting off ankle monitor
daily.summary: A US judge orders Thomas Markle to go to jail after he allegedly cut off his ankle monitor, which was a condition of his bail after being charged over child sexual abuse material.

daily.title: Review finds Bendigo hospital did not follow procedure for brain deaths
daily.summary: A review of deaths at Bendigo Health's intensive care unit finds a patient's relative felt "hurried" and "pressured" to decide about organ donation, with four cases raising significant concerns.

daily.title: Missing father in dispute with criminal rivals before disappearing, police say
daily.summary: NSW Police said when the family called his mobile phone on the night of his disappearance, they believed they could hear a man screaming before the call ended.

daily.title: Sinner targeting Australian Open return after earlier 'impossible goal'
daily.summary: The two-time champion at Melbourne Park has no plans to miss out next year after having his 2026 season cruelled by injury.

daily.title: Damning report urges new investigations into Epstein associates
daily.summary: US politicians are calling for further investigations into Jeffrey Epstein's associates in a scathing report blaming prosecutors, financial institutions and powerful connections for allowing his abuse to continue.

daily.title: Lifesavers to trial AI tool to detect rip currents
daily.summary: UNSW researchers say the tool can pick out a rip in a photograph of a beach, and hope it can be used to help save lives.

daily.title: Live: Wall Street retreats as hot inflation shortens odds of a rate hike, ASX set to slide
daily.summary: Wall Street hit the brakes as higher-than-expected inflation looks to have cemented a December rate hike, while the ASX is priced to slide as well. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

daily.title: South Road scandal to become subject of parliamentary inquiry
daily.summary: The Malinauskas government's handling of alleged bikie infiltration into the $15.4 billion Torrens to Darlington project is set to face more scrutiny.

daily.title: Live: Transport minister says Qantas job cut decision 'extremely disappointing'
daily.summary: Catherine King says Labor would have considered taking a stake in the national carrier if it were in government during the COVID pandemic. Follow live.

daily.title: 100yo soldier corrects service records, receives medals 80 years later
daily.summary: Ian Hart wore replica medals for decades after serving in the Australian Army. He has now been awarded the official service medals he earned.

daily.title: Experts urge people not to drink unpasteurised milk as products pushed online
daily.summary: A recent national survey by the Food Safety Information Council found about one-in-six Australians are consuming potentially dangerous raw milk products.

daily.title: Victorian polling centre closures a 'kick in the teeth', say voters
daily.summary: Residents in central Victoria say the closure of three local polling booths is a "kick in the teeth" for rural communities, with some facing longer trips to vote in the upcoming state election.

daily.title: IVF patient fears Catholic takeover will affect quest to become a mum
daily.summary: Moments before going into surgery, Hayley Deniss was told about a potential disruption to her IVF care.

daily.title: Motorcyclist and car driver killed in crash in Melbourne's south-east
daily.summary: A motorcycle rider and a car driver died at the scene after their vehicles collided, with police investigating the circumstances.

daily.title: Workers at notorious youth justice centre compensated $7m for violence
daily.summary: Workers reported occupational violence every 2.6 days in the three years before Malmsbury Youth Justice Centre closed in 2023. It has since reopened as the Victorian government pledges a youth crime crackdown.

daily.title: UK arrests US Army member suspected of helping Russia
daily.summary: British police say a ‌senior member of the US Army ‌has been arrested over allegations that he was assisting Russian intelligence.

daily.title: Australia considering world-first criminal charges for AI companies
daily.summary: Australia could become the first country to prosecute AI companies for failing to take reasonable steps to prevent harmful conduct by their models.

daily.title: SA Labor slammed 'basketball stadium' to fix ramping but the crisis is far from over
daily.summary: While ramping remains at near record levels, the SA government isn't shy about investing in new sporting facilities and major events.

developing.title: Live: Tax office boss concedes consultation failures on credit card ban
developing.summary: The head of the tax office says he would have consulted more closely with small businesses if he had his time again, conceding the ATO should have had a more open conversation before rolling out the credit card ban. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: US staring down December and March rate hikes as Fed leaves rates on hold
developing.summary: The US Federal Reserve has held interest rates unchanged at its most recent meeting, but in Australia, high inflation data means we're likely to hike. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Erin Patterson awaits appeal decision on mushroom murder convictions
developing.summary: Three judges from Victoria's Court of Appeal will hand down their judgment on Erin Patterson's appeal against her murder convictions and on the prosecution's appeal over her sentence.

developing.title: Live: Federal government launches probe into future of Australia Post
developing.summary: Communications Minister Anika Wells says a parliamentary inquiry will examine whether Australia Post is keeping pace with Australians' needs for the future. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: ASX set to edge up despite $US500b Alphabet share slump overnight
developing.summary: The Australian share market is likely to rise on opening this morning with ASX 200 futures up 15 points overnight. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: South Africa extends lead over Australia as new ball taken
developing.summary: Pat Cummins ends his lengthy drought with a crucial strike before the lunch break on day four in Cape Town. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Jillaroos running over World Cup minnows Wales with try-scoring blitz
developing.summary: Australia has already qualified for the semifinals of the women's Rugby League World Cup, and will be keen to continue their momentum with a win over Wales. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Albanese to seek tighter rules for British backpackers in meeting with UK PM
developing.summary: Anthony Albanese will seek a tightening of rules for British backpackers coming to Australia when he meets his UK counterpart this week. Follow live.
